[USER] gbsteatfeeoggdfsgiaggebagesgafdf easier to not screw up the escaping
[USER] ggbodedfegigagbbgoagfacbzdeszate but that is the only difference
[USER] gbsteatfeeoggdfsgiaggebagesgafdf the only one of consequence i think
[USER] okay
[USER] there's also some minor things like you don't need a lt title gt in a srcdoc document
[USER] and i may have said that it's always in standards mode i forget
[USER] i think i didn't find the place which describes the structure of srcdoc document
[USER] i thought it would be parsed like data text html
[USER] well like anything else
[USER] can't remember if parser creates lt title gt automatically
[USER] no
[USER] oh another difference is that relative urls in srcdoc documents resolve relative to the parent doc
[USER] with data urls you can't use relative urls
[USER] similarly referer headers get set correctly for srcdoc docs but not data docs
[USER] anyway the net result is that a srcdoc works better than data would and you don't have to be as verbose and you're less likely to screw up the escaping which makes it more secure in practice
